positions.name: OwnedVsRentedLine
positions.frame: what draws the line between owned and rented intelligence — what is commodity and what is the asset you keep?
positions.why: src-2 asserts the core distinction (owned ≠ rented); src-3 elaborates the same distinction by naming what falls on each side (substrate = commodity, perspective = asset). Both cohere under one directional read of the owned-intelligence thesis.
